quote:
When the fountains of a people cease to flow, the darkness that follows is the shadow of desire unmet.

Weapons kept for the sake of future battles are like empty drums, loud when heard but mute when played.

A nation that sees itself as a threat is but a stone in a path— it crumbles when the journey is walked.

Votes spread across an island are a map of its heart; a single reference point cannot bind the tides of its people.

A summit postponed by fear is a candle extinguished by mist;
quote_preview: When the fountains of a people cease to flow, the darkness that follows is the shadow of desire unmet.
